# JPEG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF fixture corpus

These small binary fixtures are original procedural works generated by
[`generate.mjs`](./generate.mjs). No third-party image source is used. Codlume
licenses the generator and generated fixtures under the MIT license in
[`LICENSE.md`](./LICENSE.md).

[`manifest.json`](./manifest.json) records the exact Sharp, libvips, and Node
versions used for this checked-in corpus, plus the FFmpeg and AV1 encoder used
for the AVIF sequence. It also records each file's SHA-256, byte size, decoded
dimensions, MIME/container facts, and expected eligibility classification.
Re-running the generator with a different native toolchain can change encoded
bytes and therefore requires reviewing and committing the new manifest
checksums. Regeneration requires FFmpeg with the `libsvtav1` encoder.

Large resource-boundary images do not belong in this corpus; those are created
in test-owned temporary storage.
